text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega has injured herself during
training,
so I accompany her to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They told me not to move it until it's
fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I knew something felt wrong, but I
ignored it. And
now I'm faced with this
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But that still isn't a reason for me to be
idle.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, but I'm going to go
running. My
training has to continue.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Let's focus on treatment for now.
Let's figure out a way to train.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've got to train harder than anyone else.
I have
no other choice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right... I know that. Still...
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, you won't even b...
If it gets worse, you won't even b...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega appears unconvinced but
follows my
advice and rests up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega heads to the gym in the
hopes of
training in a way that won't
affect her injury.
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I felt a slight twinge...
But it's nothing to
worry
ab—OUCH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop her from continuing, but her
recovery ends
up taking longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tape up the injured area to strengthen
support.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt.
I think I'll be all right like
this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll be fine for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we come up with a way to
avoid
stressing her injury, and she
manages to finish
training safely.
